item.title: Zelenskyy furious as Trump announces deal to buy Russian diesel
item.description: President says deal essential to lower US fuel prices but move set to create fresh crisis with Ukraine and Nato allies US politics – live updates Donald Trump was on a fresh collision course with the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, and European allies on Friday after a stunning agreement to buy Russian diesel, upending years of US and western pressure on the Kremlin to end its four-and-a-half year war against Ukraine. Zelenskyy reacted furiously to Trump’s announcement of the deal with President Vladimir Putin of Russia, calling it “absolutely terrible” and “not fair and not… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Robert Tait in Washington

item.title: French PM Addresses Student Demands as Protests Shut Hundreds of Schools, Lead to 6,000 Detentions
item.description: French PM Sébastien Lecornu pledged to respond by late October but stopped short of meeting student demands, as protesters took to the streets Thursday for nationwide demonstrations dubbed “Act IV.” Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
